Complete all visible map EDGES naturally: upper perimeter behind HUD has segmented LOW terracotta tribal wall pieces, ivory tusk arch posts, indigo clan banners and small drums, with sunlit layered red-rock hills peeking beyond. Left and right perimeter gently blend paving into tan sand, green desert plants and low red-rock layers. No gray rim anywhere, no hard unpainted rectangle cutoffs, no stretched floor texture stood vertically as a high wall, no giant block. If a boundary has perspective depth it must be lovingly painted sandstone layers in its own perspective.
Decorate INTENTIONALLY in fixed peripheral groups, not randomized scatter. Base most environment props on the game's existing pottery supply boxes, bone war totems, shield/signal gong, columns/arches and crystal beacons. Add ONLY a few preview additions: one pale giant rib-bone swing with an indigo sling in far upper-right/back scenery; one small friendly sand-spider capture-net station in far upper-left side pocket; one smiling tusk-carved tribal doorway integrated at upper left edge. Keep these out of the combat center and behind UI when necessary. Two small terracotta supply containers with indigo woven lids and one short tusk flag pole can create a lower-side grouping. No mass spectators, no extra market stalls, no giant industrial tools.
Color palette: warm sand gold, bright terracotta, ivory bone, vivid indigo textile, turquoise accents, fresh sage desert plants. Rounded clean linework, imaginative but readable art, cheerful adventurous faction culture, actual small enemy sprites stay same scale. Central and lower-center floor remains free for movement and combos.
This is a concept effect preview based on existing assets, not a claim of already shipped gameplay. Do not put that sentence into the artwork, record in metadata only.
